entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker who was a conquest-obsessed human warlord until an ancient artifact transformed him into a demon; he saps enemies' life force with deadly magic.

events.summary: In his pursuit of power, an ancient magical artifact transforms the human warlord Ob Nixilis into a demon.
events.quote: In his pursuit of power, an ancient magical artifact transformed him into a demon.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis, after first seeking to remove the curse, embraces his new form and its power.
events.quote: he eventually embraced his new form and the power it gave him.
